spine.parents: Only merge from exact gated predecessor selected by Mission Control. This roadmap worktree starts at the pinned research baseline.
spine.shared_file_policy: Single lease holder per tracked source path across assignments. Explicit handoff for shared modules. Research agents write isolated docs. Merge tier lanes in predecessor order.

ordered_work.work: Complete FL9_1 evidence, establish suite and candidate schema; review public native gaps.
Separate native levels from public validation level; store caps, runtime, selected shaders and optional-feature folds; hard-fail exact mismatch, default baseline.
ordered_work.promotion: Source/base regression, no speculative features exposed

ordered_work.work: Prepare file leases around stage/format/binding changes and shared maximum constants; preserve old downlevel API, default D3D11 opt-in, Core validation and DX12/ANGLE behavior.
ordered_work.promotion: Affected workspace tests and agreed native-extension plan

ordered_work.work: FL9_2: separate color/alpha blend, two-sided stencil, occlusion, 32-bit native IA, repeat and DDI additions
ordered_work.promotion: FL9_2 certification record and all earlier exact-tier regressions

ordered_work.work: FL9_3: actual profile switch, restricted instance draws, equal-bit-depth MRT4, volume/cube, texel formats
ordered_work.promotion: FL9_3 certification record and all earlier exact-tier regressions

ordered_work.work: FL10_0: shader model 4 with geometry/stream output, NPOT, eight attachments, arrays, optional DirectCompute
ordered_work.promotion: FL10_0 certification record and all earlier exact-tier regressions

ordered_work.work: FL10_1: shader model 4.1, IA 32, independent blend, cube arrays, sample-frequency and required format-specific 4×
ordered_work.promotion: FL10_1 certification record and all earlier exact-tier regressions

ordered_work.work: FL11_0: SM5 compute/tessellation, typed and raw UAVs, indirect draw/dispatch, required BC6H/BC7
ordered_work.promotion: FL11_0 certification record and all earlier exact-tier regressions

ordered_work.work: FL11_1: explicit runtime path, CS/OM 64, graphics stages, OM logic, constant windows and forced sampling
ordered_work.promotion: FL11_1 certification record and all earlier exact-tier regressions

product.baseline: Current compatibility rendering remains FL9_1 class across selected D3D11 hardware tiers.
research: Shader API 0.2 and Iris pack support have different pipelines; execute expected fixtures under real capabilities.
GPU culling requires actual compute, storage and the product's count-driven indirect feature or an approved product adaptation.
HDR requires actual swap-chain/color space/panel/display and OS support. Keep SDR fallback and matching reviews.
DRS/frame timing and performance compare CPU fallback, timestamp-permitted profile and genuine higher-level candidate with controlled settings.

hold_conditions: Freeze fork, upstream and relevant product full commits, actual source status, CTS checkout/revision, test lists, binaries and signed package hashes.

Resolve every required operation, numeric boundary and required DXGI format/use cell, including inherited rows and runtime footnotes. Assign an owner and reproducible positive and negative fixture to each row.

Verify driver flags, native operation, reachable DX11 HAL and independently observable public tests where representable. For a native API gap require an approved reachable interface and execution through the backend, plus public limitation documentation.

Run lower-tier regressions at all prior exact levels, dedicated native-ceiling hardware and required signed AppContainer configurations. Record real hardware, architecture, driver/WDDM, runtime and shader projection. Require actual operation evidence and do not count skips or query-only observations as passes.
Validate each tier with independent review and have Mission Control issue the approved immutable gate only when zero mandatory rows or required tests remain open.
